note: BH-7942. Cuts every HOLD read of the pool after this many seconds: the open ai-build listing pages, an issue GET and a comments read (POOL_GH_READ_TIMEOUT_S still cuts the PR, branch head and repo reads). A cut read is read once more in the tick before the row is skipped; after one row's retry also fails, the rest of the tick reads once per row. A non-number uses 45 with one line. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_hold_read_timeout_s`. 0 = off: no per-read limit.
